parameters.content:
## 🍔 FOOD DELIVERY ORDER AUTOMATOR
**What it does:** Your food-delivery app posts order events to a webhook → the workflow acks instantly → dedupes repeat events → routes by event type → notifies the restaurant, dispatches drivers (first-accept claims it), sends AI-drafted customer updates, handles failed payments and cancellations → logs every stage to Google Sheets → Telegram summary.

**You'll need:**
- A food-delivery app/backend that POSTs order webhooks (or any system that can POST JSON)
- OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com)
- Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials
- Telegram bot token + your chat ID (@BotFather → /newbot)
- Restaurant / driver / customer notify endpoints (your backend, WhatsApp Business API, or any HTTP endpoint)

**Status flow in Sheets:** `NEW` → `CONFIRMED` → `DISPATCHED` → `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` → `DELIVERED` (plus `PAYMENT_FAILED` and `CANCELLED`)
**Events:** `order.created` · `restaurant.confirmed` · `driver.assigned` · `driver.picked_up` · `order.delivered` · `payment.failed` · `order.cancelled`

## STEP 1 — Webhook intake + instant ack
Food-delivery app POSTs an order event → normalize into one clean shape → Respond to Webhook answers immediately so the sender never times out while the rest runs.

## STEP 2 — Idempotency dedupe
Read logged events → if this order_id + event_type was already seen, skip all notifications (no duplicate messages when many orders arrive at once). New events get a row appended with status `NEW` — the row itself is the in-flight reservation.

## STEP 3 — Route by event type
Switch sends each event to its own branch: created → restaurant, confirmed → dispatch, assigned → AI customer update, picked up / delivered → status, payment failed → hold + retry, cancelled → release + refund flag.

## STEP 4 — Event branches
Restaurant confirmation, driver dispatch (first-accept claims it), AI-drafted customer updates, failed-payment hold + retry, cancellation release + refund review. Every branch updates the sheet status before merging.

## STEP 5 — One Telegram summary
All branches merge → a single summary (order, event, outcome, AI-drafted customer message) → Telegram.
